name: Dumbbell Forearm Supination
steps: Sit with your forearms resting on your thighs and your hands beyond your knees, palms down around horizontal dumbbell handles.
Grip each handle off center so the longer lever is on your thumb side and rotate your forearms outward until your thumbs point up.
Slowly lower the thumb ends inward until your palms face down again.
tips: Keep your upper arms still as your forearms rotate.
Keep your wrist in line with your forearm as you turn the thumb side of the dumbbell upward.
